conf.description: SQL Server Audit audit-security-log / jdbc-sql: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: sqlserver-audit / audit-security-log / jdbc-sql. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (custom logs-microsoft_sqlserver.audit ingest pipeline (fn_get_audit_file result-set branch)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
